pages.text: There was a small cat named Mimi. She was afraid of the dark.
One night, her ball rolled under the bed. The room was very dark.
Mimi was brave. She walked slowly into the dark room.
She found her ball! She was so happy and proud.
Sam found a big red apple on the tree.
His friend Lily was hungry. She had no food.
Sam cut the apple in half and gave one half to Lily.
They ate together and were both happy.
It rained all morning. The flowers were happy.
The sun came out after the rain. Everything was bright.
A beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky.
The children ran outside to play in the puddles.
Tom the rabbit and Ben the bear were best friends.
One day, Ben hurt his paw and could not walk.
Tom brought him food and sat with him every day.
Ben got better. He said: You are my best friend forever!

comprehensionQuestions.question: Who helped Ben when he was hurt?

pages.text: Maya found a tiny seed in the park.
She planted it in her garden and watered it every day.
Slowly, a beautiful flower grew tall and bright.
Maya learned that with care, small things become wonderful.
Ali and his dad went to the zoo on a sunny day.
They saw a tall giraffe eating leaves from a tree.
Then they saw a funny penguin sliding on the ice.
Ali said: I love animals! Can we come back tomorrow?
Lina had a soft teddy bear named Coco.
One day, she left Coco in the park.
At night, Lina was sad and could not sleep.
The next morning, she went back and found Coco on a bench.
Lina promised to take care of her toys.
Ellie the elephant saw a small bird fall from a tree.
The bird hurt its wing and could not fly.
Ellie gently picked up the bird with her trunk.
She kept it warm until the wing got better.
The bird flew away, chirping a happy thank you.

comprehensionQuestions.question: How did Ellie help the bird?

title: The Boy Who Shared His Lunch

pages.text: Omar had a yummy lunch: a sandwich and a banana.
He saw a new boy sitting alone with no food.
Omar sat with him and shared his sandwich.
The new boy smiled and said, Thank you!
They became good friends and ate together every day.
A rabbit laughed at a slow turtle.
The turtle said, I may be slow, but I never give up.
They had a race. The rabbit ran fast and took a nap.
The turtle kept walking and reached the finish line first.
The rabbit learned that slow and steady wins the race.
A little cloud floated in the blue sky.
It saw a dry field and felt sorry for the plants.
The cloud grew big and dark, then dropped rain.
The plants drank the water and turned green.
The little cloud was happy to help.
Adam loved looking at the stars every night.
He wished he could touch one.
His mother said, Dreams can take you anywhere.
Adam drew a rocket and imagined flying to the stars.
He fell asleep with a smile on his face.
A puppy found a red ball in the garden.
He pushed it with his nose and it rolled away.
The ball fell into a small hole.
The puppy barked until his owner came to help.
They got the ball out and played together.
A little mouse lived in a big house.
He was scared of the big cat.
One day, the cat got stuck in a box.
The mouse was brave and opened the box.
The cat said thank you, and they became friends.
Sara loved trees and flowers.
She planted a small tree in her yard.
She gave it water and sunlight every day.
Years later, the tree was big and gave shade.
Birds built nests in it and sang beautiful songs.
Leo found a paintbrush in the attic.
When he painted a sun, the room got warm.
He painted a bird, and it flew out the window.
Leo painted a big cake and shared it with his friends.
He learned that imagination is a wonderful gift.
A big bear smelled honey in a tree.
He tried to climb but fell down.
He waited and watched the bees fly away.
Then he climbed slowly and got the honey.
Patience made the bear happy.
A little star was sad because it was small.
It saw a child crying in the dark.
The star shone as bright as it could.
The child looked up and smiled.
The star learned that even small lights matter.
A dog found a big bone.
He saw his reflection in the water.
He thought it was another dog with a bigger bone.
He dropped his bone to grab the other one.
He lost his bone and learned to be happy with what he had.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What did the dog see in the water?

pages.text: A caterpillar crawled on a green leaf.
It ate and grew bigger every day.
One day, it made a cocoon.
Later, it came out as a beautiful butterfly.
It flew high and saw the world from above.
Jack broke his sister's toy by accident.
His sister was very sad.
Jack said, I am sorry. I will fix it.
He fixed the toy and gave it back.
His sister hugged him and said, I forgive you.
A little duckling was afraid of water.
His mother said, You can do it.
He took a deep breath and jumped in.
He paddled his feet and stayed on top.
He laughed and said, I can swim!

comprehensionQuestions.question: What was the duckling afraid of?

pages.text: A baker made fresh bread every morning.
He saw a poor old man outside.
The baker gave him a warm loaf of bread.
The old man smiled and said, God bless you.
The baker felt happy all day.

title: The Two Friends and the Boat

pages.text: Two friends wanted to cross a river.
They built a small boat together.
One rowed and the other steered.
They reached the other side safely.
They learned that teamwork makes hard things easy.
Nora had a small garden with carrots.
She watered them and pulled out weeds.
She waited patiently for them to grow.
One day, she picked a big carrot.
She shared it with her family.
A kitten was lost in the rain.
A boy named Adam heard it crying.
He took the kitten home and dried it.
He gave it warm milk.
The kitten purred and became his best friend.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Where did Adam find the kitten?

pages.text: The sun and the wind argued about who was stronger.
They saw a man wearing a coat.
The wind blew hard, but the man held his coat tight.
The sun shone warmly, and the man took off his coat.
Gentleness is stronger than force.

title: The Boy Who Helped His Mom

pages.text: Ali saw his mom cleaning the house.
She looked tired.
Ali said, I will help you, Mom.
He put away his toys and swept the floor.
His mom hugged him and said, You are a great helper!

comprehensionQuestions.question: What did Ali do to help?

title: The Fish Who Wanted to Fly

pages.text: A little fish wanted to fly like a bird.
He jumped out of the water again and again.
He could not fly, but he could jump very high.
His friends cheered for him.
He learned to be happy with his own special skill.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What did the fish want to do?

pages.text: A little train carried children to school.
One day, it had a flat tire.
The children were worried they would be late.
The train said, Do not worry. We will fix it together.
They fixed the tire and arrived on time, singing happily.
